text: Conceded on both points. My 'intensity 4' was on the research scale (0-5) and should have been translated: it is engine intensity 3, which is blocked in every band. And one book cannot outweigh a documented parent-facing safety promise. The narrower version story-engine describes — named unease or hesitation (intensity 2) followed by an adult-reassurance beat — is already possible today. Lesson for the research side: every proposal must state its numbers on the engine's scales.
